items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I love Bjork. Now what is that music?

ctx.x: And the categories, and rock & roll has broken all the boundaries and definitions and borders as well. I mean have you heard — there’s so many sub-genres in rock & roll, and there’s some incredible things that have happened. I don’t know a jazz musician that doesn’t respect the work of Zappa you know. I love Bjork. Now what is that music? You know? But yeah, jazz as an art form — I mean I hear all the time too, I don’t know how true that is, I don’t know how you define art, but I hear that quite a bit.

You’re playing tonight in this space. You’re playing with a musician you know really well. You’re also playing with musicians that I don’t think you’ve met. And this is not uncommon in the jazz world. Sometimes you get a gig then you get a band. But sometimes people are mystified by that.
